title: Detector schedule config (ds_*)
description: Chooses which detectors run on which dates, e.g. special events and holidays. Keys of dates are 'default', a date (YYYY-MM-DD) or an inclusive date range (YYYY-MM-DD - YYYY-MM-DD). Time-of-day and day-of-week rules belong in dg_ entries. Fields not defined here are treated as comments by the server.

name.x-errorMessage: is not a valid detector schedule name: it must start with ds_

propertyNames.x-errorMessage: is not a valid schedule key: use 'default', 'YYYY-MM-DD' or 'YYYY-MM-DD - YYYY-MM-DD'

name.description: Label for this schedule entry, e.g. "Special Event".

date.description: Must repeat the key this entry is stored under.
